mapper.select: SELECT TRANSLATION_GROUP , TRANSLATION_TYPE , TRANSLATION_CODE , TRANSLATION_LOCALE , TRANSLATION_CONTENT , DATA_STATUS , CREATED_BY , CREATED_AT , UPDATED_BY , UPDATED_AT FROM TRANSLATION WHERE TRANSLATION_GROUP = #{translationGroup} AND TRANSLATION_TYPE = #{translationType} AND TRANSLATION_CODE = #{translationCode} AND TRANSLATION_LOCALE = #{translationLocale}
